newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Costello says GDP consistent with employment.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Costello says GDP consistent with employment.

text.p: Australian Treasurer Peter Costello said on Wednesday September quarter GDP figures were consistent with budget employment forecasts.
"Growth at this level is consistent with our budget forecasts and our budget forecast is two percent employment growth through the year," Costello told reporters.
"And by the end of the year producing falls in unemployment," Costello said.

Figures released earlier on Wednesday showed that Australia's seasonally adjusted average gross domestic product (GDP-A), which averages income, expenditure and production measures of GDP, rose 0.8 percent in the September quarter.
Real GDP-A in the year to September rose 3.8 percent.
